title: Synthetic storm (made-up practice data)
summary: Ten made-up daily frames of a warm storm that travels a known path, a cold patch and a day with no data, for practice and tests.
description: A pretend sea with grey land along the east edge. A warm storm travels in a straight line from the north-west towards the south-east over the first nine days. A small cold patch appears near the coast on the sixth, seventh and eighth days only. On the tenth day the whole map is missing data. Every value and every place is chosen by us, so where each hot spot is on each day is known exactly. None of it is real data.

source.name: Made-up practice data
source.credit: Made up for testing; not NASA data

regions.name: Open sea
regions.description: A grid of 30 points across the open water, clear of the land.
